product_overview: Storm44 is a free AI-powered study workspace that converts user-provided PDFs and YouTube transcripts into searchable, cited study materials (notes, flashcards, quizzes) and provides an AI Tutor that answers questions grounded in those sources.
core_goals: Allow users to ingest PDFs and YouTube links and persist extracted chunks and embeddings to a pgvector-backed PostgreSQL store.
Provide an AI Tutor (RAG) that answers user questions with grounded citations to source chunks.
Enable scoped retrieval so queries and generators operate only over user-selected sources.
Generate and persist study assets (flashcards and quizzes) derived from ingested sources.
Deliver a responsive 3-panel workspace UI (Sources, Chat, Study Tools) with resilient backend endpoints and instrumentation.

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Liveness probe to verify backend availability and basic readiness.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 200 with {"status":"ok"}
GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 500 with service error detail (indicates degraded service)

features.name: Source Ingestion
features.description: Add study materials by uploading PDFs or pasting YouTube URLs; pipeline extracts text, chunks, and embeddings and persists them as a source with chunks and embeddings.
user_flows: POST /ingest with body {type: "pdf", file: <multipart>} -> Receive 202 Accepted with {source_id} (ingestion queued) -> GET /sources/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with source metadata (id, title, type) -> GET /sources/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with chunks_count > 0 (ingestion completed)

POST /ingest with body {type: "youtube", url: "https://youtube..."} -> Receive 202 Accepted with {source_id} (ingestion queued) -> GET /sources/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with status 'processing' or 'completed'
POST /ingest with YouTube URL that has no transcript available -> Receive 400 with error 'transcript unavailable' (user-facing failure)
POST /ingest with duplicate URL already ingested -> Receive 409 Conflict with error 'source already exists'

features.name: AI Tutor (RAG Question Answering)
features.description: Accept a user question, retrieve top-k similar chunks from the vector store, and return an LLM-generated answer with per-claim citations referencing chunk_id and source_id.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/ask with body {query: "Explain X", top_k: 5} -> Receive 200 with {answer: string, citations: [{source_id, chunk_id, snippet, url}] }
POST /api/v1/ask with body {query: "", top_k: 5} -> Receive 422 validation error (query min_length violation)

POST /api/v1/ask with body {query: "What does Y mean?", source_ids: ["uuid-not-in-db"], top_k: 5} -> Receive 200 with answer and citations (but citations may reference chunks outside requested source_ids due to current retrieval implementation) -> Developer note: this indicates known limitation where source_ids filter is ignored
POST /api/v1/ask with body {query: "Complex Q", top_k: 20} -> Receive 500 with internal server error detail (LLM or retrieval failure)

features.name: Scope Selection
features.description: Allow users to restrict queries and generators to a selected subset of sources so results and citations only come from those sources.
user_flows: POST /query with body {query: "Summarize chapter", source_ids: ["uuid-1234"], top_k: 5} -> Receive 200 with answer and citations where each citation.source_id == "uuid-1234"
POST /query with body {query: "Summarize chapter", source_ids: [] , top_k: 5} -> Receive 200 with message 'no sources selected' or answer indicating no scoped content found
POST /query with body {query: "Ask", source_ids: ["nonexistent-uuid"], top_k: 5} -> Receive 404 with error 'source not found' (invalid scope)

POST /query with body {query: "Ask", source_ids: ["uuid-1234"] , top_k: 5} -> Receive 200 but citations include other source_ids (regression of scoping enforcement) -> Developer note: indicates scoping filter not enforced at DB retrieval layer

features.name: Flashcard Generation & Study Mode
features.description: Generate a persisted flashcard deck for a selected source, each card including front/back text and a citation to the originating chunk; users can retrieve, delete, and use cards in study mode.
user_flows: POST /flashcards/generate with body {source_id: "uuid-1234"} -> Receive 202 Accepted with {job_id} (generation started) -> GET /flashcards/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with [{id, front, back, citation_chunk_id}] (persisted deck available)
GET /flashcards/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with empty array (no flashcards generated yet)
POST /flashcards/generate with invalid source_id "not-a-uuid" -> Receive 404 with error 'source not found'
POST /flashcards/generate with body {source_id: "uuid-1234"} -> Receive 500 with error 'generation timeout' (LLM/provider failure)

features.name: Quiz Generation
features.description: Generate multiple-choice quizzes from a selected source. Each question includes options, the correct answer, an explanation, and a citation to the source chunk; quizzes are persisted for later retrieval and review.
user_flows: POST /quizzes/generate with body {source_id: "uuid-1234", num_questions: 10} -> Receive 202 Accepted with {job_id} -> GET /quizzes/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with [{id, question, options, correct_answer, explanation, citation_chunk_id}]
POST /quizzes/generate with body {source_id: "uuid-1234", num_questions: 1000} -> Receive 400 validation error (num_questions out of allowed range)
POST /quizzes/generate with invalid source_id -> Receive 404 'source not found'
GET /quizzes/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with empty array (no quiz generated yet)

features.name: Sources CRUD & Workspace Sync
features.description: Manage sources: list, retrieve, and delete ingested materials; used by the Sources panel to keep the 3-panel workspace in sync with backend state.
user_flows: GET /sources -> Receive 200 with [{id, title, type, created_at, deleted_at}] (list of user sources)
GET /sources/{source_id} -> Receive 200 with full source detail and chunk summary (used to populate Sources panel and highlight citations)
DELETE /sources/{source_id} -> Receive 204 No Content (soft delete applied) -> GET /sources/{source_id} -> Receive 404 (source soft-deleted)
GET /sources when DB connection fails -> Receive 500 with error detail (Sources panel shows error state)

features.name: 3-Panel Workspace Layout
features.description: Front-end layout with resizable Sources (left), Chat (center), and Study Tools (right) panels; panel state persisted client-side and synchronized with the backend where applicable (e.g., active source selection).
user_flows: GET /sources -> Receive 200 with list of sources (left panel populates source list) -> POST /query with selected source_ids to start chat -> Receive 200 with answer and citations (center panel chat uses scoped data) -> GET /flashcards/{selected_source_id} -> Receive 200 with flashcards to populate right panel

Client resizes panels (localStorage persisted) -> No backend call required (client-side persistence) -> On reload GET /sources -> Receive 200 to repopulate panels (UI restores last active source and panel sizes)

GET /sources -> Receive 200 with many large sources loaded -> UI remains responsive (virtualization expected) -> Developer note: verify backend supports paging of /sources if large lists cause latency
GET /sources -> Receive 500 service error -> UI shows fallback error and suggests retry

tech_stack.other: Pydantic v2, Uvicorn, SentenceTransformers (MiniLM-L6-v2), OpenAI gpt-4o-mini

features.name: RAG Question Answering
features.description: Accepts a user question, retrieves top-k similar chunks from pgvector, and returns a GPT-generated answer with citations

endpoints.description: Answer a question using RAG over ingested sources

features.name: Database Connection Pool
features.description: Async asyncpg connection pool with SSL support for Azure PostgreSQL, initialized on startup and closed on shutdown

features.name: Source Ingestion DAL
features.description: Atomic transaction inserting a source, its chunks, and embeddings; rolls back on failure

features.name: Vector Similarity Search DAL
features.description: Retrieves top-k chunks by cosine distance using pgvector <=> operator, scoped to provided source UUIDs

features.name: Flashcard CRUD DAL
features.description: Bulk insert, retrieve, and delete flashcards per source

features.name: Quiz Question CRUD DAL
features.description: Bulk insert, retrieve, and delete quiz questions per source

known_limitations.issue: No dedicated /ingest endpoint — ingestion only available via crud.py DAL directly
known_limitations.impact: Cannot trigger source ingestion via HTTP; pipeline runs separately
TC_BE_002, TC_BE_003, TC_BE_004 test cases reference non-existent endpoints

known_limitations.issue: No authentication or authorization on any endpoint
/api/v1/ask calls answer_question_structured which uses file-based embedding retrieval, not the DB DAL (retrieve_similar_chunks)
known_limitations.impact: source_ids filter in AskRequest has no effect on retrieval
